messages:
nina: Quick design check: proposing a compact 'schema lane' for tool calls in run history. Each lane shows fn name, type pill (Structured/Text), elapsed, and a one-line collapsed summary. Mock in Figma: https://figma.com/s/b33mocks leo: Love compactness. Two accessibility asks: 1) collapsed summary should be readable by screen readers (role=button + aria-expanded), 2) lane headers need meaningful labels for keyboard nav. maria: Agreed. For headers I want 'fetchOrders() · Structured · 120ms' as the visible string, and aria-label="Tool fetchOrders, structured result, 120 milliseconds". Collapse toggle will be a real button. sam: Copy nit: prefer 'Result' over 'Output' in collapsed state. Example: "Result: 3 orders (partial)". Keep it short for translations. leo: Keyboard: left/right to move lanes, Enter to toggle, Tab to reach quick actions (Copy JSON, Open schema). Add visible focus ring and ensure high-contrast mode shows clear outline. nina: Streaming behavior: append lines but only update aria-live once on finalization: "Tool result complete for fetchOrders". While streaming show visually an animated dot and small "streaming" label, but avoid noisy SR updates. maria: Good. Implementation snippet I'll add to Figma notes: ```html
fetchOrders() · Structured · 120ms
...
``` sam: Add tooltip + SR announcement for copy: "JSON copied to clipboard". Keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C) would be great to power users. leo: Also ensure we don't auto-scroll a lane if user focus or selection is inside it. If new content arrives and user interacted, show a tiny "new" badge they can jump to. nina: Performance: lazy-render deep nodes in nested structured outputs. Breadcrumb-based drill-in to expand only the path the user needs. Breadcrumbs must be keyboard navigable. maria: I'll update frames with ARIA labels, keyboard map, and copy alternatives (short/long). Will ping for another pass. aria-bot: Action items: nina -> implement Figma updates; leo -> keyboard + a11y test plan; sam -> copy strings for i18n; maria -> wireframes updated.
